sentiment_summary: Safari luggage receives praise for its attractive design, smooth wheels, and good value, but a notable share of reviewers highlight durability concerns such as thin plastic shells, weak joints, lock failures, and a single severe case of breakage with poor customer service. The mix of high‑star praise and recurring mid‑to‑low‑star complaints results in an overall mixed sentiment.

wheels.summary: Multiple reviewers highlight smooth, buttery wheels that glide effortlessly (e.g., “Wheels are buttery smooth”, “wheels glide smoothly”, “Sturdy wheels”), with no reported wheel failures.

handle.summary: While many praise the handle as comfortable and easy to use (e.g., “drag handle is great”, “handle is comfortable”), a few note poor quality (“Telescopic Handle is of worst quality”, “Handle quality slightly a let down”).

zipper.summary: Zipper quality is repeatedly described as very good or well‑made (e.g., “zipper quality is very well”, “internal zip adds great utility”), with only cautionary remarks but no actual failures.

material.summary: Reviews are split: many commend the shell as scratch‑proof and sturdy, yet several call the plastic thin and suggest durability concerns (e.g., “thin material”, “plastic fiber shield is very thin”).

size.summary: The majority find the size ideal for short trips and cabin carry‑on (“perfect middle size”, “size is perfect”), though a few mention slightly less utility space.

durability.summary: Positive durability feedback appears (“nice durability”, “sturdy and well‑built”), countered by isolated reports of breakage within months and weak joint areas.

value_for_money.verdict: At the ₹2,889 budget price, customers repeatedly describe the luggage as a great deal, noting premium‑like finish, smooth wheels, and solid build. Only a handful of negative experiences (breakage, service issues) are reported, so overall the quality justifies the price.
